meta.tagline: The membership register of Ghana's seventeenth region.

legal.notAGovernmentDocument: Region 17 membership is a standing in a community. It is not a government document and confers no citizenship, residence, visa, or right of entry.
legal.referral: Questions about citizenship, Right of Abode, or the Ghana Card go to Ghana's Diaspora Affairs Office or the Ministry of the Interior. We refer. We do not advise on eligibility.

join.title: Join the register
join.emailHelp: We send a sign-in link. No password.
join.birthHelp: Month and year only. You must be 18 or older.
join.handleHelp: This may be changed once, ever.
join.affirmAction: I affirm the Compact and the Code of Conduct.

consent.title: Consents
consent.help: Nothing is shared unless you turn it on. Every choice here can be withdrawn at any time in settings.
consent.daoop_sharing: Share my record with the Diaspora Affairs Office programme
consent.aggregate_research: Include my record in anonymised aggregate research

errors.handleAlreadyChanged: A handle may be changed once only.
